tools.name: edit
tools.description: Replace exact text in an existing file. oldText must match the file's current text exactly and occur once unless replaceAll is true; an empty newText deletes the match. Use write to create files, replace whole files, or write binary content.

path.description: Path relative to cwd or an absolute path.

oldText.description: Exact text to replace, copied from a read.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring exactly one. Defaults to false.

backup.description: Back up the file before replacing it; the session decides where backups are kept. Defaults to true.
